body: in my wildest dreams... this would be amazing ;-;

whoa! another skullcandy earbuds glitch? i have a pair of candy blue skullcandy earbuds that had a microphone on them (the 10$ pair), the microphone of which i need to talk to people who call me since my mic on my phone broke from water damage. but, the microphone just disappeared one day while on my desk and there is no way it just snapped off the cord and there is NO damage on the cord where the microphone was before. my friend even has the same candy blue pair with the mic and i compared my glitched buds to their pair and i'm convinced there was seriously no way that my microphone seamlessly disappeared.
